comments.body:
I reviewed the full solution against problem.tex. The problem asks to determine, for all 0<=a<=b, the fields over which U_{a,b} is representable. The solution gives the complete and correct classification (trivial range a in {0,1,b-1,b}; for 2<=a<=b-2 the threshold b<=q+1 with the even-characteristic exception b=q+2 iff q even and a in {3,q-1}), with the sharp MDS bound properly isolated as the single cited external input (Theorem thm:mds).

Verification performed:
1. Reformulation lemma, trivial range, Vandermonde sufficiency: checked, all constructions valid (every a-subset has nonzero determinant).
2. Even-q construction (conic + nucleus) for U_{3,q+2}: numerically verified over GF(2),GF(4),GF(8),GF(16) that ALL 3-subsets of the q+2 points form a basis. Confirms Prop nec(2) (<=).
3. Rank-2 counting bound (Lemma rank2): correct (q+1 distinct 1-dim subspaces of F_q^2).
4. Duality (Lemma dual): verified by exact rational computation (200 random complementary pairs, a,b-a in 2..4) that for G=[I_a|A], H=[-A^T|I_{b-a}], det H_S = +/- det G_T for every complementary (S,T), and that each equals +/- the same minor of A.

Fix made: the duality lemma previously asserted det H_S = +/- det G_T somewhat hand-wavily ("this is the standard fact ..."). I replaced that paragraph with a fully rigorous two-claim proof (Claim A: det G_T = +/- det A[P\\T, T cap Q]; Claim B: det H_S = +/- det A[P\\T, T cap Q], via Laplace expansion along the identity-block columns and transpose-invariance of the determinant), making the iff explicit with the set-theoretic bookkeeping (squareness, S cap P = P\\T) spelled out. The written argument matches the numerically confirmed identity.

No mathematical gaps remain; all "representable" directions are constructive and self-contained, and the only external input (the MDS maximum-length theorem) is correctly attributed and used solely for the sharp necessity b<=q+2. Resolving.
